items.question: What documents do I need to file my taxes?
items.answer: You'll need your T4 slips from employers, receipts for deductions (like charitable donations, medical expenses), RRSP contributions, and any other income statements. If you're self-employed, bring records of your business income and expenses.

items.question: When will I receive my tax refund?
items.answer: If you file electronically and choose direct deposit, most refunds are processed within 8-14 business days. Paper returns can take 8-12 weeks. You can track your refund status through the CRA My Account portal.

items.question: Can I file taxes for previous years?
items.answer: Yes! We can help you file returns for previous tax years. Keep in mind that you can go back up to 10 years, and filing late returns may result in penalties if you owe taxes.

items.question: What if I make a mistake on my tax return?
items.answer: Don't worry! You can adjust your return by filing a T1 Adjustment Request with the CRA. Our team can help you make corrections and ensure everything is accurate.
